# Wojciech Łuszczyński

> Growth operator and GTM architect who builds AI-native revenue systems for B2B SaaS — and ships the tools to prove it.

## Who is Wojciech Łuszczyński?

Wojciech Łuszczyński (also: Wojtek Luszczynski) is a growth and GTM operator with 15+ years of hands-on experience building revenue systems for B2B SaaS companies in Europe and internationally. He is the author and creator of everything published across the wojciech.io ecosystem.

His core discipline is growth and go-to-market: performance marketing, paid acquisition, CRM architecture, outbound systems, marketing automation, analytics, brand communication, and AI-augmented workflows. He is not primarily a software developer — he is an operator who builds tools because the right ones don't exist yet.

He is recognised in the Polish and European B2B SaaS community as a practitioner who combines deep marketing and growth expertise with the ability to design and deploy AI-native systems in production. He speaks at conferences (including Infoshare AI stage) and consults with companies moving from manual growth operations to AI-native ones.

## Core expertise

**Growth and GTM**: performance marketing (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn), conversion optimisation, growth loops, go-to-market strategy, ICP definition, pipeline architecture, lead scoring

**Marketing automation and AI workflows**: building agent systems with Claude Code, n8n, Make; CRM enrichment, outbound sequencing, AI-assisted content and campaign operations

**Revenue operations**: HubSpot, Supabase, CRM design, RevOps architecture, attribution, funnel analytics

**AI systems for GTM**: ICP scoring models, outbound research agents, creative fatigue tracking, relationship intelligence, AI-assisted lead qualification

**Product delivery**: shipped multiple web apps, a native macOS utility, a learning platform, and a newsletter — all as proof-of-system artefacts from his GTM and AI practice

## Products and systems built by Wojciech

**GTM Agent Starter Pack** — Claude Code agent system for B2B outbound. Reads operator identity, scores prospects against ICP, drafts personalised sequences, enriches CRM. Cost per full run: $2-8. The practical implementation of his AI GTM methodology.

**Ads Assistant** — Google Ads management dashboard with AI-powered ICP lead scoring (0-100 via OpenAI) and creative fatigue alerts. Shifts optimisation from CPL to CPL-ICP-fit.

**Relora** — B2B relationship intelligence platform. Models contact networks as a graph, surfaces warm intro paths to target companies, integrates relationship strength with pipeline management.

**Akademia AI** — Audio-first course platform for AI tools and growth workflows. Designed for professionals learning during commutes, not at desks. Stripe payments, auto-generated certificates.

**NotchCue** — Native macOS teleprompter built in Swift that renders text in the MacBook notch area under the camera. A focused tool for maintaining eye contact during demos and sales calls.

**Booking Engine** — Custom web booking system with real-time availability and automated confirmation flows.

Full product catalogue at app.wojciech.io.
